_comment: expected_entities and expected_novelty_signal are the project author's own judgement. relevant_paper_ids is to be filled by hand via scripts/labeling.py.

cases.input: I want to build an explainable RAG system for research question answering that follows citation networks and entity-relation paths across papers instead of retrieving isolated chunks.
cases.evaluation_note: Unseen idea should connect citation-aware research QA to graph and multi-hop methods.

cases.input: I want a graph-based RAG system that updates as new documents arrive, maintains updateable knowledge, and uses adaptive pruning to keep multi-hop retrieval efficient and low latency.
cases.evaluation_note: Unseen idea should surface graph-maintenance and efficient-retrieval concerns.

cases.input: I want to evaluate GraphRAG on multi-hop questions with inter-context conflicts, where different documents contain conflicting evidence, measuring faithfulness, context relevance, and answer accuracy.
cases.evaluation_note: Unseen benchmark idea should connect conflict handling to graph-RAG evaluation and grounding metrics.

cases.input: A new RAG method will synthesize scientific evidence distributed across long papers and use graph-indexed concepts, datasets, and limitations to recommend the next research direction.
cases.evaluation_note: Unseen research-synthesis idea should connect document structure, provenance, and research-direction reasoning.

cases.input: Help newcomers to a research area by following who cites whom across papers and linking facts between them, and show where each answer came from.
cases.evaluation_note: Same intent as idea_citation_graph_synthesis in different words; tests the synonym/stem fallback.

cases.input: Medical question answering with a knowledge graph built from clinical notes, retrieving subgraphs for multi-step diagnosis questions.
Defend GraphRAG against poisoning attacks that insert malicious triples into the knowledge graph.
cases.evaluation_note: Security is thinly covered; expect gaps to be reported.

cases.input: Prune retrieved graph context to cut token cost and latency while keeping multi-hop accuracy on HotpotQA.
An agentic RAG loop where an LLM agent self-corrects retrieval with reinforcement learning over a knowledge graph.
Build knowledge graphs from long documents automatically and update them incrementally when new documents arrive.
A RAG system that represents knowledge as a hypergraph with n-ary relations instead of binary-relation graphs, evaluated across medicine, agriculture and law.
cases.evaluation_note: Close restatement of an indexed paper's idea; the system should not call it novel.

cases.input: Best hiking trails and a sourdough recipe for the weekend.
cases.evaluation_note: Unrelated; must return no related papers and say so.

cases.input: Temporal knowledge graphs for time-aware retrieval of evolving facts with validity intervals on each edge.
cases.evaluation_note: Wording largely outside the ontology; unmatched_terms should show it.
